caption.text:
With CNG, hybrid and EV cars now collectively overtaking petrol in market share,
the real shift is towards lower running costs and practical ownership.

Before buying your next car, compare your daily running, home charging access and nearby CNG availability - not just fuel type.

[Petrol, CNG, EV, fuel, Car]

caption.text:
CNG cylinder hydro-testing is a safety check, not an optional expense.
It checks for rust, cracks and weak cylinder walls under high pressure.
Get it done every 3–5 years. It usually costs ₹1,000–₹1,500 with the compliance plate and certificate.
Expired test date? The CNG station can refuse refuelling.
Check it. Don’t risk it.

#cng #hydro #test #indiareels

caption.text:
Why are sunroofs so popular in India when our weather often makes them impractical?
For most buyers, a sunroof is less about daily use and more about natural light, an airy cabin, premium appeal, status and resale value. It works best in pleasant weather, but for many Indians, it’s also an emotional “top-model” feature.

#sunroof #carinfo #indian #cars #fyp

Is India’s EV charging network really road-trip ready?

caption.text:
Bade tyres = zyada speed? 🚗💨

Bigger wheels/tyres can change your car’s overall gearing, acceleration, mileage, handling and even the accuracy of your speedometer.

Aur agar modification manufacturer-approved size se bahar hai, toh legal trouble bhi ho sakta hai. 👀

So next time koi bole “Bade tyres laga, speed double ho jayegi"

bas usko ye reel dikha dena. 😂

Tyre bada ho ya bill? 😭💸

Comment karo 👇

caption.text:
More Things to Avoid While Driving ⚠️

Ignoring blind spots
Mirrors don’t show everything. Always do a quick shoulder check.

Coasting downhill in neutral
It reduces your control over the vehicle.

Using cruise control on wet roads
It can make loss of traction harder to manage.

Driving on very low fuel regularly
It can leave you stranded and may affect the fuel system over time.

Rushing through yellow lights
Trying to beat the signal can create unnecessary risk

Drive Safe, Stay Safe

[car insurance,drive safe,cars]

caption.text:
CNG blending is coming - but unlike E20,
existing CNG car owners may not need to worry about engine compatibility.

Under the GOBARdhan Scheme,
CBG blending will gradually rise from 3% to 5%, making CNG greener without changing your car or refuelling setup.

Would greener fuel make you consider a CNG car?

[CNG, E20, BLENDING]

caption.text:
Rust is silently reducing your car’s life and resale value in India.

• ₹87,098 crore: estimated annual corrosion cost
 • 75% of 5–7-year-old cars show surface rust
 • Rust means higher repair bills and weaker body panels
 • Galvanized steel improves corrosion protection
 • Zinc coating may add only 1% to a car’s price

Before buying a car, check its rust protection, galvanized steel usage and corrosion warranty - not just mileage and airbags.

#carinfo #cars #india

caption.text:
Would you buy a 5-year-old used EV?

Before buying a used electric car, check:

• EV battery health and remaining capacity
• Real-world driving range
• Fast-charging history
• Accident or waterlogging damage
• Transferable battery warranty
• Service and repair records
• Battery test from an OEM or trusted EV centre

A used EV’s resale value depends more on battery health than kilometres driven. 

A verified EV battery health report can help buyers, banks and insurers determine fair value.

caption.text:
Challan aaya hai, but samajh nahi aa raha next step kya hai?

Sabse pehle apne vehicle ka challan status check karo. Understand karo ki challan kis stage par hai, uske details kya hain, aur uske baad hi available next step decide karo.

ChallanPay is built to help vehicle owners get better clarity around their traffic challans before taking action.

Discover. Understand. Then decide.

Check your vehicle status at challanpay.in

caption.text:
From conversations with founders, leaders and visitors to people checking their vehicle challans with @challanpay.in, the Lawyered space at @ideabaazofficial Startup Fest 2026 became a place where mobility questions turned into real interactions and, in many cases, clear next steps.

Our team spent the fest listening, explaining and showing what accessible legal support can look like when it is built closer to the road and the people who use it.

A few moments from the ground and a closer look at what we mean when we talk about building legal infrastructure for mobility.

 @challanpay.in @lots_247 @_himanshugupta___ @startupwithsyed @sarafgautam1 @pegasus7880 @maninder_singh_bawa @katyalamit2003 @ranjoy.da @anmitforever 

#Lawyered #IdeaBaaz #IdeaBaazStartupFest #ChallanPay #LOTS247

Challan check karo. Samjho. Resolve karo.

caption.text:
Day 1 at @ideabaazofficial Startup Fest 2026 and what a start.

From a steady stream of visitors at the Lawyered stall to people checking their vehicle challans with @challanpay.in, exploring our solutions and having conversations around mobility and roadside legal support with @lots_247, Day 1 kept the team busy throughout.

As the RoadSmart Partner, it was great to see people engage not just with the brands, but with the real problems we’re working to solve across India’s mobility ecosystem.

Great footfall. Great conversations. And plenty more ahead.

One day down. Four more to go.

See you tomorrow at Bharat Mandapam.

📍 Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi
📅 26–30 August 2026

#Lawyered #IdeaBaaz #IdeaBaazStartupFest #ChallanPay #LOTS247

caption.text:
This golgappa wala just casually broke the sound barrier, launched customers into the stratosphere, and had NASA show up — all in one afternoon. Somewhere in the chaos, a guy crashed through a ClearTrack office ceiling and landed in a chair. The employee wasn't even surprised. If Delhi street food can defy physics, settling your challan with 30% cashback is honestly the least wild thing you'll do today. Contact ClearTrack at +91-9312246401 and get it done. 🌀🫧

Before you scan a QR or enter your UPI PIN, always verify the amount and confirm if the money was actually credited to your account.

Stay alert. Stay scam-free. 💙

caption.text:
No missed call. No suspicious link. No OTP.

Yet people have lost lakhs through a scam most of us have never heard of: SIM Swap Fraud.
If your phone suddenly loses network while everyone else's is working, don't ignore it. It could be a sign that someone has taken control of your number.

Watch till the end to learn how this scam works and the steps you can take to protect your money.

Share this with your friends and family. It could save someone from losing their savings.

#ScamAlert #CyberSafety #DigitalSafety #MobiKwik
[Scam Alert, Cyber Safety, Digital Safety, MobiKwik]
